description: Rerun of covid_first_look_v2 on the declared scenario: the COVID hull spec now opts sars_cov2_resp out of the ship-wide boarding channel (HullScenario._initiation_block), so a cell boards the declared index case only. v1 and v2 cells also boarded a prevalence-drawn cohort (profile 1% passengers, 0.6% crew at epoch 6, about 34 hosts on Diamond Princess) that the scenario never declared. Same grid, same matched seeds, same objective; v2 and v3 cells are paired by (Theta, seed).

grid.note: Half-decade points from 1e4 to 1e9; the single-seed fit's grid with the midpoints added.

fit.note: Matched seeds: every candidate sees the same 20 seeds, so candidate differences are paired.

held_out.note: Scored at the fitted Theta and reported at its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity; the rest of the grid is stored, not scored.
